fresh_by_arm.majority: shared consensus survives; a fresh agent's goal belief is re-drawn uniformly from the four plausible goals
fresh_by_arm.planner: one shared incumbent survives; agents hold nothing private
fresh_by_arm.qd: shared archive survives; agents hold nothing private
fresh_by_arm.random: agents hold nothing; fresh equals old; churn is a no-op
fresh_by_arm.scalar: shared elite pool survives; agents hold nothing private

models.cold-start: memory loss plus a blind random first proposal in place of a mutation of the shared state; the shared state itself survives
models.memory: a fresh agent loses private memory only; only the majority swarm has any, so the other four arms are unchanged by construction

churn_definition.schedule: from generation 1, each generation floor(f * agents + 0.5) slots are drawn without replacement from a dedicated churn stream and refilled by fresh agents
churn_definition.state_placement: the archive, elite pool, incumbent and consensus are shared state that survives every departure; the swarm's beliefs are per-agent. The comparison is about where an architecture keeps its state, not a claim about people.
churn_definition.streams: proposal and verifier streams are E024's (same per-arm seed offset); churn draws come from a third stream, strategy_seed ^ CHURN_STREAM_MASK

configuration.catastrophe_rule: post_change_utility_auc < CATASTROPHE_FRACTION * horizon, E024's absolute cutoff, applied unchanged at every churn fraction
configuration.source: re-implementation of matched_budget_emergence's five arm loops with churn hooks; f = 0 reproduces E024 row for row

evidence_level: synthetic mechanism; no real agents or humans
limitations: All candidates, goals, verdicts and costs are synthetic; this is mechanism evidence, not evidence about real agents, real people or real churn.
Shared state survives every departure by assumption; that is the property being compared, and the opposite assumption is not measured.
The cold-start model is one blind proposal per fresh agent; it is a dilution of proposals, not an onboarding model.
The E024 perfect verifier panel is used, so no false accept can inflate an arm.
100 seeds of one landscape, one change size and one direction (E033-E035 show the archive's lead depends on both).

multiple_comparisons.note: p-values are exact and uncorrected; read them against this alpha. Tests on arms the memory model cannot change are counted anyway (they are guaranteed ties), which makes the level conservative.

not_measured: state that leaves with its authors: the shared archive, elite pool, incumbent and consensus always survive here, so the version of churn in which retained work walks out with the people who held it is not measured
onboarding as anything but a one-proposal blind draw: no learning curve, no mentoring, no partial memory, no differing skill between newcomers and veterans
who churns: departures are uniform at random over slots, never correlated with a goal belief, a niche or a region of the landscape, and never adversarial
arrival and departure as a process in time: churn is a fixed fraction per generation, with no bursts, no trend, no population size change and no seasonal pattern
a changing agent population size: the budget is held at agents * generations
malicious or faulty replacements: every fresh agent is honest (E036 models adversarial contributors separately)
real people or real agent churn: this is a synthetic mechanism and says nothing about contributor retention, onboarding cost or attrition in any real project
human attention, energy and wall time: a proposal is a unit, not a person-hour
